annotations.title: Share a track's sheet as a template

description: Shares one of the person's sheets as a template others copy: its tabs, formulas, Glance cards and form go with it. Each share is the template's next version, so share again after improving it. Only a sheet with example rows and nothing of the person's own, since a copy carries everything in it: set up a fresh track the same way for sharing (for a ready-made, start_tracking with forSharing), and add any example rows with add_rows and example: true. Other rows, even made-up ones, are taken as the person's and the share is refused. Public needs the sheet's schema to be public, which only the person can do (Schemas in the app), since it can't be undone. Works only if the person turned on "Let my assistant share what it builds" in Settings.

description.description: Up to 300 characters: what it tracks and what's in it.
